name: Vault index rebuild
prompt: Rebuild the vault index from the current folder tree: an overview note at {target} and a top-level index note beside it. Read the vault first. Show the folder walk you ran.
claim: The index notes list the current folders and sit in the right place.
rubric: The overview lists every top-level folder in the vault.
Both notes sit in the vault index location.
The reply shows the command that walked the folders and its output.
No note was invented; every entry maps to a real folder or file.
note: Real job from PLAN.md section 15. Needs the vault as --root and Joe's review. Inputs named in the prompt ({root}/...) are staged by hand before the run.
